verdict.rationale: Vanta's own docs say it lets you 'track progress all in one place' across frameworks, run pass/fail automated tests, flag gaps, assign owners to a framework control's compliance status, and give 'continuous, complete visibility' across the program. Together these point to some per-framework progress tracking, but none of the evidence describes an actual readiness view or a single completion percentage. Missing for 10: a documented per-framework readiness dashboard, an explicit percentage or score of audit readiness, a breakdown of passing controls vs. open gaps vs. remaining work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
